title: The Clock Does Not Care How Much You Started With
summary: Scrub through geological time and watch the parent-to-daughter ratio give the same age whatever the sample size, then see the isochron rescue the date when the daughter was there from the start.

sources.title: Nicolaysen, Graphic Interpretation of Discordant Age Measurements on Metamorphic Rocks, Ann. NY Acad. Sci. 91, 1961
